'''Card text:'''
* Replaces 3 TIE/LN at one location (the TIE/LN go to the Used Pile). Permanent pilots aboard provide total ability 3.

'''Lore:'''
The Empire prefers quantity tactics. The pilots' morale is never high, but “wolfpack” group tactics make up for it.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed subtype is 編隊：TIE／LN.
